_contract: WHAT THE MAINTAINER DECIDED, and only that. Every other field of the authorization -- identities, stages, plan hash, row selection's price, ceiling -- is DERIVED by d2_authorization.build_payload from the tree it binds, and this grant is REFUSED if it states one (GRANT_MAY_NOT_STATE).
_one_use: ONE grant, ONE issuance, ONE launcher session. A run id is never reused to reset spend; an ordinary pre-science engineering failure is repaired and re-issued inside the accepted range (AGENTS.md P12.1).
granted_by: maintainer, 2026-10-14 UTC: Post-Stage-W-R2 Scientific Approval and Conditional D2 Search Authorization (independent review of 7211e142), confirmed by the maintainer directly. Scientific GO for the D2 v3 Full Search as an explicit research-investment decision; the registered Stage W rubric's literal result was BETWEEN and is not rewritten as GO.
covers: ONE D2 v3 formal SEARCH session under preregistration v3: the frozen original teacher; Top-200 + tail teacher confidence; the teacher-union-candidate Top-200 + tail KL against the root reference; full scope (DEPTH, FFN, WIDTH, ATTENTION, state evaluation, beam); beam width 6; bsz 3, length_sorted_v1, scored_v1; the preregistered Top-4 quality retention committed and fetched. It trains nothing and runs no behavioural probe.

accepted_range.expected_usd: about 11.14 at scored_v1 (re-derived at the live rate)
accepted_range.rule: the issuer re-derives the exact ceiling at the live quote; a ceiling above this range is not authorized and needs a new maintainer decision

does_not_authorize: a change of protocol, K, mapping, support or beam
decision_record: logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-10-14 (D2 v3 GO: preregistration approved, $595 cap, formal search granted)
authorizes: nothing by itself: a launch needs the issued one-use authorization
